text: At the open grave, as the imam raised his hands in final prayer, Mor Lam realized with stark terror that his stubborn pride had outsmarted his common sense.
Meanwhile, back at the compound, Awa looked at the cooling pot of marrow.
Convinced that grief required sustenance, she ladled the rich, golden stew into bowls for the mourning neighbors.
By the time Mor Lam finally broke his trance and scrambled out of the cemetery, Moussa was sitting happily on his veranda, wiping a clean bone with a warm smile: 'Ah, Mor Lam!
Even in your passing, your hospitality feeds the village!'
